definitions.tail: year<=ceil-rank1pct boundary; include all year ties
definitions.household_share: known positive households with valid year
definitions.tail_share: complexes with valid year, including unknown households

limits: Retained transaction-derived inventory, not a census of currently standing or occupied apartments.
No absolute oldest building, identity, exact minimum, exact count or denominator is published.
Tail boundary belongs to the stated parent population. Regional rows distribute that tail, not the oldest1pct selected within each region.
Five-year inclusive year bands; percentage intervals are lower-inclusive and upper-exclusive except100. Household totals and shares are half-up rounded.
Unknown households are not imputed. Known-household coverage is not coverage of all housing.
Suppression is not zero or a ranking. All comparison rows remain; repeated forty-year totals are identical.
No safety, reconstruction eligibility, historical surviving stock, price or investment inference.
